purpose: §7 critique #7 — does MLP-only LoRA also close the FVQ/CVQ gap? Tests whether the 'amplification via attention' framing is structurally circular (attention-only LoRA can only reweight; can't install MLP features).
data_source: deterministic-seed ARB train (same 18k examples as main Qwen LoRA)
comment: Target modules are MLP-ONLY. Attention {q,k,v,o}_proj are FROZEN in this run.

compared_to_attention_only_lora.note: MLP-LoRA has ~1.5x more trainable capacity (intermediate_size > hidden_size).

implication: Both attention-only and MLP-only LoRA close the gap. The capacity is in the network; either pathway suffices. The §7 'amplification not installation' claim must be reframed: the L30-L33 attention promoter heads (§5.1) are A WAY to express the task, not the ONLY way.
